events.title: Co-op Preview is Here!
events.summary: Co-op has arrived in On the Rocks as a Preview, letting up to four players jump into the same world together for the first time.Create a lobby, invite your friends through Steam, and run your bar, explore the wasteland, complete quests, trade, fight, drive and survive together.As this is the first Preview of our multiplayer system, you may encounter bugs or rough edges while playing. events.title: DEMO NOW AVAILABLE! - Play On the Rocks right now!
events.summary: Wasteland barkeepers, the wait is over! The playable demo for On the Rocks is officially LIVE and FREE on Steam right now! Watch YouTube Video What’s Waiting for You in the Demo? This demo focuses directly on our core gameplay loop: scavenge resources, craft radioactive drinks, serve wasteland survivors, and defend your bar from mutant waves.Bar Management: Step behind the bar, take orders, and run the show.Scavenge & Craft: Brave the dangerous desert for raw materials and use industrial machine
